lines: Chandi jaisa rang hai tera, sone jaise baal
couplets.en: Your skin has the sheen of silver, your hair the glow of gold.

lines: Ek tu hi dhanwan hai gori, baqi sab kangal
couplets.en: You alone are rich, my fair one, and all the rest are beggars.

lines: Jis raste se tu guzre, woh phoolon se bhar jaye
couplets.en: Whichever path you take fills with flowers.

lines: Tere pair ki komal aahat, sote bhaag jagaye
couplets.en: The soft sound of your footsteps wakes sleeping fortune.

lines: Jo patthar chhoo le gori tu, woh heera ban jaye
couplets.en: Any stone you touch, my fair one, turns to diamond.

lines: Tu jisko mil jaye, woh ho jaye malamal
couplets.en: Whoever finds you comes into a fortune.

lines: Ek tu hi dhanwan hai gori, baqi sab kangal
couplets.en: You alone are rich, my fair one, and all the rest are beggars.

couplets.en: You alone are rich, my fair one, and all the rest are beggars.

lines: Jo berang ho, us par kya kya rang jamate log
couplets.en: What shades people paint over anything colorless.

lines: Tu nadan na jane kaise roop churate log
couplets.en: In your innocence, you have no idea how people steal beauty.

lines: Nazrein bhar bhar dekhein tujhko, aate jate log
couplets.en: Passersby look their fill as they come and go.

lines: Chhail chhabili rani, thoda aage ghoonghat aur nikal
couplets.en: Lovely queen, draw your veil a little farther forward.
